captions.detailed: A small octagonal rooftop cupola with alternating louvered side panels sits on a dark flat roof plate. Inside the cupola housing, a cast yoke supports a bronze bell on a horizontal pivot shaft, which allows the bell to swing back and forth. A central decorative finial rises from the apex of the dark conical roof, completing the architectural structure.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a rooftop cupola with an octagonal frame, alternating louvered window sections, and a conical roof topped by a decorative finial. Inside the cupola, mount a bronze bell on a horizontal pivot shaft so that it can swing freely.
captions.factory: Construct a square roof plate base using a box primitive. Create the octagonal cupola housing by arraying frame posts and horizontal louvers radially at 45-degree intervals. Model the conical roof using a revolved profile or a cone primitive, topped with a small cylinder and sphere for the decorative finial. Inside the structure, model a yoke and horizontal pivot shaft, then construct the bell body using a revolved profile, attaching it to the shaft via a revolute joint to enable swinging articulation.
